errors.splitTotal: The parts must add up to the payment.
errors.amountPositive: Amount must be more than zero.

errors.lastAccount: You need at least one open account.
errors.reassignSame: Pick a different category to move things to.

errors.accountAndCategory: Pick an account and a category.

errors.targetPositive: Target must be more than zero.

errors.paydayRange: Payday must be a day between 1 and 31.
errors.savingsNotNegative: Savings must be zero or more.
errors.thresholdNotNegative: Threshold must be zero or more.

errors.backupTooNew: This backup is from a newer version of Mizan.

errors.trialDate: Enter the date the free trial ends.
errors.attachmentType: Attach a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF.
errors.attachmentSize: That file is too large. Attach files of up to 2 MB.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.everydayNote: “Safe to spend” uses accounts marked as everyday. Move money between accounts with a transfer from
accounts.openingHint: Enter the opening balance as an amount, e.g. 250 or -120.50
accounts.openingNote: Opening balance is what the account held before the first transaction you record here. Use a minus sign for money owed on a card.
accounts.aprHint: Enter the interest rate as a number, for example 22.9.

categories.title: Categories
categories.archiveNote: Its transactions, bills and rules move to another category. Its budget is removed.

nav.dataLocal: Your data stays on this device.

bills.title: Bills
bills.subtitle: Direct debits, standing orders and subscriptions
bills.nothingSoon: Nothing due in the next 30 days.

activity.title: Activity
activity.comingUpNote: Bills due in the next 7 days. They join your activity once paid.

reports.title: Reports
reports.forecastLabel: Forecast balance for the next 45 days. Lowest {{amount}}.
reports.forecastExplain: Everyday accounts, with upcoming bills on their due dates, about {{daily}} a day of spending (your last 30 days) and {{income}} expected each payday.
reports.transfersExcluded: Transfers between your accounts are not counted.

lock.wrongPin: That PIN is not right. Try again.
lock.title: Mizan is locked
lock.intro: Enter your PIN to open the app.
lock.forgot: Forgot your PIN? Clear this site’s data in your browser settings to start again (restore a backup afterwards).
lock.useBiometric: Unlock with Face ID or fingerprint
lock.biometricFailed: Could not unlock with biometrics. Use your PIN.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Your data is safe on this device. Reloading usually fixes this.

update.ready: A new version of Mizan is ready.

home.overdueBody: No payment recorded yet. Check and mark them as paid.
home.lowBalance: Your balance may drop to {{amount}} around {{date}}
home.lowBalanceBody: Based on upcoming bills and your usual spending.
home.backupBody: Your data only lives on this device. Download a backup to keep it safe.
home.perDay: About {{amount}} a day until payday on {{date}}
home.overspent: Upcoming bills and savings are more than your balance.
home.nothingDue: Nothing due in the next month.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.rolloverNote: Includes what was left from last period.
budgets.editIntroMonth: Set a monthly limit for each category you want to track. Leave it empty for no budget. Total: {{amount}} a month.
budgets.editIntroPayday: Set a monthly limit for each category you want to track. Leave it empty for no budget. Total: {{amount}} a pay period.
budgets.amountHint: Enter the budget as an amount, like 250
budgets.householdNote: Shared with your household. These budgets count only spending on shared accounts, and everyone in the household can change them.

billForm.deleteBody: Its past payments stay in Activity as ordinary transactions.
billForm.pausedHint: Hidden from upcoming bills and “safe to spend”

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Saving for something
goals.setAsideShort: You set aside {{amount}} each pay cycle, which is not enough to hit every deadline.
goals.setAsideOk: You set aside {{amount}} each pay cycle.
goals.empty: No goals yet. A holiday, a new laptop, an emergency fund…
goals.perMonth: {{amount}} a month to get there on time
goals.onlyGoal: This updates the goal only. To move real money, add a transfer between your accounts too.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Add transactions from your bank’s CSV statement
import.help: Most UK banks let you download statements as CSV from online banking. Monzo, Starling, Barclays, Lloyds, Halifax, Nationwide and NatWest are recognised automatically; for others, pick the columns below. Nothing leaves this device.
import.flip: Flip signs (money out shows as positive)
import.summary: {{toImport}} to import · {{duplicates}} already in Mizan · {{errors}} unreadable · {{bills}} matched to bills
import.tipSuffix: so imports land in the right categories.

settings.resetBody: This replaces everything in the app with fresh demo data.
settings.eraseBody: All transactions, bills, budgets and goals on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.restoreBody: Everything in the app will be replaced with the contents of {{file}}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyNote: Changes how amounts are shown. It does not convert them.
settings.payCycleNote: Savings are set aside each pay cycle and left out of “safe to spend”. You are warned when your forecast balance may drop below the low balance amount.
settings.rolloverHint: Unspent (or overspent) budget moves into the next period
settings.lockNote: A PIN keeps others out of the app and encrypts your data on this device.
settings.backupNote: Your data only lives on this device, so keep a copy somewhere safe.

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Automatic categories and payee names
rules.help: Used for new and imported transactions. The first matching rule wins; without one, the category you last used for that payee is picked.
rules.none: No rules yet. When you change a transaction’s category you can save it as a rule.
rules.renameHelp: Bank descriptions are tidied up automatically. Renames here apply to past and future transactions.

txForm.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
txForm.needTwoAccounts: You need two accounts to move money between them.
txForm.splitInfo: Part of a {{amount}} payment split into {{count}} parts

welcome.title: Welcome to Mizan
welcome.intro: Track everyday spending, direct debits and budgets, and always know what is safe to spend until payday. Everything stays on this device.
welcome.addLater: You can add more accounts, bills and budgets later.
welcome.haveAccount: Already use Mizan? Sign in to sync

security.alreadyOn: The app lock is already on.
security.offBody: Your data on this device will no longer be encrypted, and passkeys will be removed.
security.addPasskey: Unlock with fingerprint, face or security key
security.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. You can now unlock with it.
security.passkeyNoPrf: This device’s passkeys cannot unlock Mizan. Use your PIN.
security.passkeyUnknown: That passkey cannot unlock Mizan. Use your PIN.
security.encryptedNote: Your data on this device is encrypted and can only be opened with your PIN or a passkey. A longer PIN is harder to guess. If you forget it, the data cannot be recovered: clear this site’s data and restore a backup.
security.hideAmountsHint: Show £••• instead of balances and amounts, for when others can see your screen
security.backupPasswordIntro: Add a password to encrypt the backup file. Without one, anyone who gets the file can read it.
security.passwordWarning: Keep this password safe: without it the backup cannot be opened.
security.noPasswordNote: Leave empty for an unencrypted backup.
security.openBackupIntro: {{file}} is protected. Enter the password it was saved with.
security.wrongPassword: That password is not right, or the file is damaged.
security.nativeBiometric: Unlock with Face ID or fingerprint

sync.title: Sync and devices
sync.intro: Sign in to keep Mizan in step across your phone and computer. Your data is encrypted on this device before it is uploaded.
sync.privacyNote: Only your email address is stored readable. Transactions, amounts and names are encrypted with a key that never leaves your devices.
sync.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
sync.signedOutRemote: {{email}} was signed out on this device. Sign in again to keep syncing.
sync.codeWrong: That code is not right, or it has expired.
sync.passkeyUnknown: That passkey is not linked to a Mizan account.
sync.unreachable: Cannot reach the sync server. Check your connection and try again.
sync.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
sync.wrongRecoveryKey: That recovery key does not match this account.
sync.enterKeyIntro: {{email}} already has synced data. Enter the recovery key you saved when you set up sync on your first device.
sync.replaceTitle: Replace the data on this device?
sync.replaceBody: Transactions, bills, budgets and goals on this device will be replaced with your synced data. Download a backup first if you want to keep them.
sync.saveKeyBody: You need this key to sync another device or to recover your data. Write it down or keep it in a password manager. Mizan cannot show it to anyone else or reset it.
sync.offline: Offline. Changes will sync when you are back online.
sync.error: Could not sync. Mizan will try again.
sync.e2eNote: End-to-end encrypted: the server stores your data but cannot read it.
sync.addPasskey: Add a passkey for signing in
sync.passkeyNote: Sign in on your other devices with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of an email code.
sync.keyNote: Needed to set up sync on another device. Keep it somewhere safe.
sync.signOutBody: Your data stays on this device and on your other devices.
sync.deleteBody: Your account and all synced data will be deleted from the server. Data on your devices stays.

payday.title: It’s payday
payday.body: Check that your pay arrived and see what is safe to spend.

trialEnding.title: {{name}} free trial ends soon
trialEnding.body: Cancel before then if you don’t want to pay {{amount}}.

lowBalance.title: Your balance may run low
lowBalance.body_one: Forecast to drop to {{amount}} in {{count}} day.
lowBalance.body_other: Forecast to drop to {{amount}} in {{count}} days.

bankConsent.title: Reconnect your bank
bankConsent.body: Your bank connection expires soon. Reconnect to keep transactions coming in.

generic.renewal: A yearly payment renews next week
generic.body: Open Mizan to see the details.
generic.cardDue: A card payment is due soon

cardDue.title: {{name}} payment due in 3 days
cardDue.body: Pay {{amount}} in full to avoid interest.

returnBy.title: Last days to return {{name}}
returnBy.body: The return window for this {{amount}} purchase closes in 2 days.

warranty.title: {{name}} warranty ends in a month
warranty.body: Check it still works, and claim before the warranty ends.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new. Bills, budgets and your balance are being watched.
notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. Alerts still appear here.
notifications.enableHint: Shown while Mizan is open, and when it is closed if you use sync. Pushed reminders contain no names or amounts.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings.
notifications.quietNote: Notifications during quiet hours wait until they end.
notifications.testBody: This is how Mizan will remind you.

banks.title: Bank connections
banks.intro: Connect your bank to bring transactions in automatically. Mizan can only read balances and transactions: it can never move money.
banks.needsSync: Bank connections need sync, because the connection is made through the Mizan server.
banks.unavailable: Bank connections are not available on this server yet.
banks.failed: Could not reach your bank. Try again later.
banks.connected: {{name}} is connected. Choose where its transactions go.
banks.notConnected: The bank did not confirm the connection. Try again.
banks.pending: Waiting for the bank to confirm.
banks.expired: This connection has expired. Reconnect to keep transactions coming in.
banks.validUntil: Connected until {{date}}. Banks ask you to confirm every 90 days.
banks.disconnectBody: No new transactions will come in. Transactions already imported stay.
banks.privacy: Transactions pass through the Mizan server on their way to your device and are never stored there. The bank data service sees them too, as it does for any connected app.
banks.consentNote: You will confirm the connection on your bank’s own website or app, then come back here.

networth.title: Net worth
networth.subtitle: Everything you own, minus everything you owe
networth.chartLabel: Net worth over the last 12 months
networth.neverPaidOff: the payment does not cover the interest
networth.valueIntro: What is {{name}} worth? Mizan uses the latest value, plus any transactions after it.
networth.valueHint: Enter the value as an amount, for example 12500.

planner.title: Debt payoff planner
planner.intro: Your minimum payments add up to {{minimums}} a month. Choose how much you can put towards debts in total.
planner.avalancheHint: Highest interest first: the least interest overall.
planner.snowballHint: Smallest balance first: quick wins that keep you going.
planner.notEnough: That is less than the minimum payments ({{minimums}}). Increase the monthly amount.
planner.debtFreeBy_one: Debt-free by {{date}} ({{count}} month), paying {{interest}} in interest.
planner.debtFreeBy_other: Debt-free by {{date}} ({{count}} months), paying {{interest}} in interest.
planner.compare_one: {{other}} would take {{count}} month and cost {{interest}} in interest.
planner.compare_other: {{other}} would take {{count}} months and cost {{interest}} in interest.
planner.extraSaves_one: Paying {{amount}} more a month clears your debts {{count}} month sooner and saves {{interest}} in interest.
planner.extraSaves_other: Paying {{amount}} more a month clears your debts {{count}} months sooner and saves {{interest}} in interest.
planner.same: Both strategies give the same result for your debts.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find transactions, then edit many at once
search.deleteBody: Linked transfers and split pieces are deleted with them. You can undo straight after.
search.more_one: {{count}} more not shown. Narrow the search to see them.
search.more_other: {{count}} more not shown. Narrow the search to see them.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Bills, paydays and your balance, day by day
calendar.legend: Green dot: payday. Orange dot: bill due. Grey dot: bill paid. Balances after today are a forecast (in italics) for your everyday accounts.

tax.title: Tax helper
tax.subtitle: Income and expenses for your tax return
tax.disclaimer: This gathers what you marked for tax. It is not tax advice and does not work out tax owed.
tax.howTo: Mark a transaction with the Tax field when you add or edit it.

receipts.title: Receipts and documents
receipts.nothingFound: No amount or date found on that receipt.
receipts.filled: Filled in from the receipt. Check the details.
receipts.note: Photos are compressed and stored encrypted on your device. Reading a receipt happens on your device too.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: Split costs and keep track of who owes whom
friends.empty: No friends added yet. Add someone you share costs with.
friends.howTo: Split an expense from its screen (Split with friends), or add an entry here. This stays on your device and your own synced devices.
friends.payLinkHint: Optional: their Monzo.me, PayPal.me or Revolut link, to ask them to pay you back.
friends.reminderText: Hi {{name}}, just a reminder that you owe me {{amount}}. Thanks!

household.title: Household
household.subtitle: Share accounts with a partner
household.intro: Share chosen accounts, with their transactions and bills, with people you live with. Everything else stays private. Shared data is end-to-end encrypted with a key only household members have.
household.needsSync: Households need sync, so you can share with someone else.
household.creator: Created it
household.linkIntro: Send this link to the person you want to invite. It works once, for a week, and contains the household key: share it privately.
household.accountsNote: Shared accounts appear for everyone in the household, with their transactions and bills. Custom categories show as uncategorised for others.
household.leaveBody: Your shared accounts become private again. Accounts others shared are removed from your devices.
household.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
household.badLink: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
household.joinIntro: You have been invited to a household. You will see the accounts it shares, and can share your own.
household.joinNeedsSync: To join, first turn on sync (it only takes an email address).

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.note: Accounts in other currencies are converted at these rates for totals, budgets and reports. Type a rate to override it.
fx.unavailable: Rates are not available right now. Type them in instead.

about.title: About {{name}}

status.down: Sync service: having problems. Your data on this device is not affected.
status.none: Sync service: not reachable from here (the app works without it).

about.feedbackNote: Add your email if you would like a reply. Do not include card numbers or passwords.
about.feedbackSent: Thank you, your message was sent.
about.feedbackFailed: Could not send. Email us at {{email}} instead.
about.shareUsageHint: Counts such as “app opened” or “transaction added”, with no identifier, IP address or content. Helps us see what is used.

safe.title: Safe to spend
safe.body: Home shows what you can spend until payday, after bills and savings. It updates as you add transactions.

add.title: Add as you go
add.body: Tap + to add spending or income. Mizan suggests the category, and you can import a bank statement instead.

bills.title: Never miss a bill
bills.body: Add your direct debits and subscriptions under Bills. You are reminded the day before each one.

more.title: Your data, your device
more.body: Set a PIN and download backups in Settings. Sync between devices is optional and end-to-end encrypted.
